title: Pear's Bankruptcy, After Payers Would Not Fund Its Prescription Apps
conflicts: No material disagreement on outcome numbers: about 170 laid off (92%, 8-K) with about 15 kept, across all sources; November 2022 cut 'more than a fifth' (MedTech Dive) vs 22%, about 59 people (pharmaphorum, HLTH), consistent. Funding $409m in eight rounds (Coverager) vs 'more than $400 million' (pharmaphorum); latter used. Auction about $6 million against about $32 million debt (STAT, pharmaphorum); STAT's per-buyer wording is ambiguous, so only the total is given. Revenue figures ($10.4m vs $22m guidance) come from one publisher group (Industry Dive) citing filings; the cross-check uses the independently reported forecast cut instead. LinkedIn post dated 8 April by HLTH but quoted on 7 April by pharmaphorum; no date given.
notes: Causes limited to McCann's own words (payers, market conditions) and reporting of slow payer progress. The sale-approval hearing outcome was not read; the story says Harvest Bio 'bid' and 'later sold' the addiction apps to PursueCare (pharmaphorum, Oct 2024). SEC EDGAR pages loaded without any personal details in the request. Quote stance: affirms (Seneca's pilot, Letter 85).
